one_line: Non-elite village healers—barber-surgeons and birth attendants—who quietly sustained everyday medicine across the subcontinent.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly calloused hands from manual work
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, faint stubble shadow on jaw, a small scar on the left cheek; large anime-style dark brown eyes with a steady, reassuring gaze and a default expression of calm focus and quiet determination.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied in a small low knot at the back of the head, with a few loose strands at the temples; a simple off‑white cotton headcloth (gamchha-style band) wrapped around the forehead and tied at the back, leaving the knot visible.
appearance.costume: Era-flexible village healer outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with a right-side tie and long fitted sleeves, lightly stained at cuffs from herbal work; a plain mid‑brown cotton dhoti wrapped just below the waist and reaching to the ankles with neat pleats at the front; a narrow dark indigo woven cloth belt at the waist used to tuck small tools; a simple, faded brick-red cotton shawl folded and slung diagonally from left shoulder to right hip for use as a support cloth during procedures; bare but modestly covered feet in simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery limited to a small worn copper bangle on the right wrist and a black cotton thread around the neck, signaling modest social status rather than elite rank.
appearance.signature: A worn but carefully maintained roll-up leather healer’s kit hanging from the belt on the left hip, partially unrolled to reveal a straight iron razor, a small curved knife, two slender bone-setting splints, and a tiny pouch of herbal powders tied with string.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown village healer in an off-white angarkha, brown dhoti, dark indigo belt, brick-red shawl, black hair in a low knot with an off-white headcloth, copper wrist bangle, sandals, and a worn leather healer’s kit with razor and splints at the hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a non-elite Indian village healer who can represent both a nai barber-surgeon and a dai midwife: a lean adult with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, calm focused expression, and large dark brown eyes; thick black hair tied in a small low knot with a simple off-white cotton headcloth wrapped around the forehead and tied at the back, leaving the knot visible; dressed in a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with long sleeves and right-side tie, a plain mid-brown cotton dhoti reaching the ankles with neat front pleats, a narrow dark indigo cloth belt at the waist, and a faded brick-red shawl slung diagonally from left shoulder to right hip; add a small copper bangle on the right wrist, a black cotton neck thread, and simple brown leather sandals; their signature item is a worn roll-up leather healer’s kit hanging from the belt on the left hip, slightly unrolled to show a straight iron razor, a curved knife, two slender splints, and a tiny herbal powder pouch; keep the palette dominated by off-white, mid-brown, dark indigo, brick red, and black, and present the character front-facing with clear views of face, hair, clothing, and the healer’s kit for consistent redrawing.
